programme.desc: CCTV brings you broadcasts of finely-produced artistic dramas that closely follow the pulse of the times.

programme.title: The Case of Disappearances
programme.desc: In Misty Village, the adopted son Wen Jie is haunted by a recurring nightmare. He delves into a series of disappearance cases in the village to seek his true identity. As more villagers die mysteriously, belief in the curse of Emperor Jing Lung intensifies. Wen Jie teams up with the security chief to unveil the conspiracy and protect the villagers.

programme.title: Seoul Raiders
programme.desc: A special agent from the Japanese National Security teams up with a skilled thief to find a pair of plates used to make counterfeit USD. However, a US Embassy representative appears and steals the plates, running away to Korea with them.

programme.title: Painted Faces
programme.desc: This is based on the real-life story of Master Yu Jim Yuen who strives to run his academy in the 1960s, even as the opera culture is declining. Three young men, Sammo Hung, Jackie Chan and Yuen Biao, are determined to train under Master Yu and undergo extremely tough training before they become three of Hong Kongs biggest stars

programme.title: Mr. Virgin
programme.desc: Mr. Virgin is a romantic comedy about a twenty-nine year-old man Chao Yu-ting Alfred Chang who has seemingly been cursed. He becomes paranoid when a Feng Shui expert tells him it will be unlucky for him to marry before the age of thirty... so comical chaos line the days up to his next birthday!

programme.title: Kung Fu Jungle
programme.desc: Jailed for accidental manslaughter, martial arts master Har Hao Mo discovers a killer targeting kung fu masters across Hong Kong. Determined to stop the murders, he helps police track down Fung Yu Sau, a ruthless fighter obsessed with proving his supremacy. As the killings continue, the two martial artists are drawn toward a deadly showdown.

programme.title: The Story Of My Son
programme.desc: Li attempts to make a fortune at the horse-racing tracks, but is subsequently entangled with loan sharks. Li becomes debt-laden while his sons are harassed by debt collectors, when more heart-wrenching events begin to unfold.

programme.title: Forbidden City Cop
programme.desc: A wild and hilariously anachronistic tale of an imperial guard of the Forbidden City who has no martial arts abilities. When the emperor is abducted, he saved the day with his unusual hobby: tinkering with futuristic inventions!

programme.title: Teenage Dreamers
programme.desc: Ting Ting is a student in an all-girl high school. She tries out for the schools stage production of Romeo and Juliet with an all-boy school and promptly falls for the lead, Jackson. While Ting Ting is swept away by the excitement of her first love, Jackson turns out to be more of a player than a partner.

programme.title: Fight Back to School
programme.desc: SDU officer Chow Sing Sing goes undercover at a school to locate a missing gun. With his partner Tat, he successfully recovers the weapon, only to stumble upon a munitions smuggling ring. In retaliation, the smugglers storm the school and take students hostage, forcing Sing to risk everything to save them.

programme.title: The Medallion
programme.desc: Hong Kong detective Eddie dies while rescuing a mystical child during an international search for a human trafficking syndicate. Revived by the sacred Medallion, he gains extraordinary healing powers. However, when his ruthless nemesis also seizes its power, Eddie must storm a sinister castle and fight in a brutal battle for survival.

programme.title: Sex Beyond The Grave
programme.desc: During World War II, a singer was raped and killed by Master Tao during her escape, with all her valuables stolen as well. Since then, the Taos house became haunted. Years later, Master Taos descendant sells the house to a young couple to pay off a massive gambling debt, but the couple soon discover that it is haunted by the vengeful spirit...

programme.title: Legend Of The Dragon
programme.desc: A young man Lung leaves his rural home on a small island to seek fortune in Hong Kong. His uncle cons Lung to play in a snooker tournament using his fathers land as the bet. Lung lost the match but luckily, his childhood friend Momo encourages him to compete again using her land as the bet. Can he finally win his land back?

programme.title: Mr Vampire III
programme.desc: Taoist conman Ming fails to banish vengeful spirits and escapes with his ghostly companions. As they seek refuge in a village, they encounter an evil witch whose goal is to eliminate the human race. Ming then allies with Taoist priest Master Jiu to battle the witchbut can they prevail against such overwhelming darkness?

programme.title: Destinys Champion
programme.desc: An aging fighter relives the mistakes of his violent past through a poor and streetwise kid, who severely injures his nemesis during a battle to win a girls heart.

programme.title: Green Wood Robbery
programme.desc: Set in the early years of the Republic of China, the wealthy Kang family is brutally murdered, and their young daughter the sole witness mysteriously disappears. For decades, the haunting of the Kang house on Green Wood Lane lingers. As the truth behind the tragedy unfolds, motives of revenge and death intertwine in this chilling mystery.

programme.title: Song of the Assassins
programme.desc: A young assassin is assigned his first mission while secretly investigating the cause of his familys massacre years ago. During the mission, he finds himself entangled in a political conspiracy that has been planned for years and must use his skills as an assassin to face whatever comes his way.

programme.title: Justice, My Foot!
programme.desc: Stephen Chow plays Sung, a lawyer who uses any means necessary to help his wealthy clients escape the law. Sung retires to the countryside when urged by his wife, but when Mrs Sung encounters a woman whose husbands death has been covered up by corrupted officials, Sung returns to the court for justice to be served.

programme.title: The Mighty Peking Man
programme.desc: King Kong comes to Hong Kong in THE MIGTHY PEKING MAN, a uniquely Shaw Brothers spin on the ageless theme of beauty and the beast. The beast, seven stories high and hailing from the Himalayas, makes his way to the jungles of India in the wake of a violent earthquake. The beauty is Russia starlet Evelyne Kraft, a sexy blonde Tarzanette who is the Mighty Peking Mans best friend. Both are discovered

programme.title: Iron Kung Fu Fist
programme.desc: Martial arts master Liang Kun withdraws from the jianghu to protect the woman he loves, but his absence leads to her tragic death. Realising he can no longer escape his fate, he returns to the martial world. With the help of beggar clan leader Su Can, Liang Kun fights his way through ruthless enemies to avenge her.

programme.title: Painted Face
programme.desc: Scholar Wang Huai Qing sells paintings to save his ailing wife. He is attacked by a bird demon along the way but is rescued by Fox demon Xiao Rong. To elude the pursuit, Wang brings Xiao Rong home, sparking a love triangle and at the same time, unfolding an impending love between human and demon.

programme.title: The Comeback
programme.desc: Uncle Hua is a retired agent who owns an antique shop on an old street. When the old street is forcibly demolished by the local Green Dragon Gang one day, Uncle Huas hidden identity is accidentally revealed, and he is pursued by a mysterious organization headed by Ah Jie. A fatal duel has just begun!

programme.title: Sixty Million Dollar Man
programme.desc: Sing is a rich man studying abroad, but is so spoiled that he can never concentrate on his studies but spends his time flirting with girls. One day, Sing gets blown up by a mobster when he hooks up with his mistress, Silvia. This arrogant prankster is resurrected instead as an unbeatable cyborg with unique skills, a real job and a new true love.

programme.title: Hidden Heroine
programme.desc: A drug cartel is entrenched in the Dong Zhou area. Mei Jing of the Thunderbolt Womens Commando Unit, leads her team to attack the drug base, but they are being ambushed and the identity of Meis father as an undercover is exposed. After a fierce battle, Mei and her team manage to successfully defeat the drug cartel and rescue her father.

programme.title: Mr Vampire
programme.desc: Taoist priest Kou is assigned to re-bury a rich man, in the hope that the new tomb will bring further prosperity. When the corpse turns into a vampire and wreaks havoc in the village, his disciples are also hurt by the vampire and possessed by a female ghost respectively. How can Kou save his disciples and hunt down the vampire at the same time?

programme.title: How to Pick Girls Up !
programme.desc: Xin, a helpless loser in love, calls in to a radio show hosted by DJ Tsang to ask desperately for help. A self-proclaimed love expert, Tsang takes it upon himself to make sure Xin meets girls and leads him on a series of absurd excursions into the wild and dangerous world of modern love.

programme.title: Apurva

programme.title: Hiss..

programme.title: Sachaa Jhutha

Release Year: 1970 Director: Manmohan Desai Awards: 1970 Edinburgh International Film Festival - Best Actor - Rajesh Khanna, 1971 Winner Filmfare Award - Best Actor - Rajesh Khanna.

programme.title: Ahista Ahista 2006

programme.title: Rowdy Rathore

Release Year: 2012 Director: Prabhu Deva Awards: Star of the Year Male: Akshay Kumar Stardust Awards Favorite Action Movie Peoples Choice Awards.

programme.title: Dear Dad

programme.title: What The Fish

programme.title: Housefull 3

programme.title: Lamhe

programme.desc: 第1集n被骗出走台湾nn为求原汁原味记录冒险旅程，制作组诱骗施焯日蔡景行前赴台湾开展逾三百公里路长征，八天内由台南走到台北，每日却只有一千台币的旅费，并要完成不同任务nn二人抵达高雄后方知中伏，心情忐忑之下接受首个任务，竟然是到某处秘境进行豪华海景野餐？他们先到驰名鸭肉店购买食物，再入手交通储值卡来租用共享单车，随即向目的地出发！闷热天气下迷失方向，突然遇上野生猴子，二人闹着玩找牠帮忙引路，却不知道将招苦果.

programme.title: 兄弟帮 Big Boys Club
programme.desc: 兄弟帮是由一班好兄弟林盛斌梁竞徽王梓轩范振锋及陈国峰主持的年青人清谈节目，每集邀请歌手艺人或不同界别人士作嘉宾，进行轻松访谈，带来时下社会热话流行文化潮流玩意等多元化内容有关爱情两性，以致同性关系，是男男女女谈之不尽的话题，节目邀来不同界别的嘉宾谈情说爱，探讨两性相处之道异度空间专题，请来嘉宾分享不思议事件，如见鬼UFO奇人奇事等刺激话题.

programme.title: 命转皇后 Story of Kunning Palace
programme.desc: 姜雪宁（白鹿饰）曾费尽心机当上皇后，却在宫变中被逼自杀现在，姜雪宁的梦想就是远离权力，主宰自己的人生可阴差阳错她还是入宫做了伴读，成为帝师谢危（张凌赫饰）的学生，姜雪宁一边接受谢危的教导，一边暗暗筹谋，想要阻止燕临（周峻纬饰）即将面临的血冠礼事件经过姜雪宁和谢危的运筹帷幄，燕家满门性命得保nn血冠礼风波后，姜雪宁无意间卷入了朝廷剿灭平南王乱党的计划，与张遮（王星越饰）一起深入敌营，危急关头姜雪宁以身为张遮挡箭，但二人终是无法相守敌国大月来犯，长公主沈芷衣（刘些宁饰）毅然踏上和亲之路姜雪宁为.

programme.title: 六点半新闻报导 世界观 今日知多D News At 18:30 Global View Whats On Today
programme.desc: 翡翠台每日下午六点半，报导本地两岸及国际重要新闻.

programme.title: 东张西望 Scoop 2026
programme.desc: 东张西望星期一至日，紧贴追踪社会大事趣闻逸事，并报导娱乐圈最新动态艺人消息，以及剧集宣传和花絮今日突发环节为大家追踪即日热门新闻；专题环节，深入探讨大众关心的时事社会及民生问题，并访问相关的专家.

programme.title: 爱．回家之三代同糖 Like Mother, Like Daughter
programme.desc: 公关女皇唐万里吴若希饰独力照顾Gen Z女儿唐芯李茵彤饰，控制欲极强万里的母亲唐曹嘉冰车婉婉饰半生相夫教子，忽然觉醒，由加拿大返港，决心寻回失落时光，更搬入万里家中当年嘉冰曾因万里坚持未婚生下女儿，母女彻底闹僵，如今嘉冰却突然无预警杀入及扰乱万里的生活万里力图维持秩序，唐芯则周旋两人之间，三代同堂火花四溅，矛盾不断职场上，富二代老板空降营销大神杨帆赵浚承饰，与万里平起平坐正面交锋，万里事业与家庭同时迎来危机.

programme.title: 死有对证 Cause Of Death
programme.desc: 新任女法医程芷昕陈晓华饰从小受林琛韦家雄饰启发，立志加入法医科，入职后却被上司林琛投闲置散林琛与身为重案组高级督察的前妻高淑娴王绮琴饰水火不容，两人因女儿林雪蕾离家出走而再次交集芷昕凭借认真的工作态度赢得林琛认同，并与警员高俊马贯东饰结缘，三人渐成默契十足的办案铁三角芷昕闺密单佩嘉吴若希饰经历失恋失业打击后转任港闻记者，跟资深记者詹柏宇阮浩棕饰从欢喜冤家发展成互相扶持的伙伴正当芷昕事业步入正轨，却闻好友佩嘉死讯，誓要还原真相，为逝者发声！.

programme.title: 大唐迷雾 The Tang Mist
铁子瓹山窿 Her Railway Trip
programme.desc: 第6集n何泳芍 亲手掘琥珀废弃铁道另类方式重生n泳芍再游览一次净土之滨？皆因天朗气清！nn继续未完的三陆海岸旅程，也因好天气，令泳芍无座位，但能在铁道上看到多个美景已值得！抵达被誉为视野最开扬车站的堀内站，更是不枉此行nn转巴士到一间博物馆，除了参观琥珀的展品外，还可亲手采掘？nn小坂曾是矿业产量冠军的日本城镇，其铁道却已废线，却凭借一批有心人致力保存，让游人得以参观，甚至预订卧铺列车夜宿此外，还可在弃用路轨上踏单车往返？泳芍形容，踏着单车似在拍MV！.

programme.title: 娱乐头条 EXTRA
programme.desc: 每晚紧贴香港娱乐圈的消息，以至世界各地的影视娱乐新闻，报导艺人最新动态剧集和电影宣传演唱会精华颁奖礼盛况等，甚至远赴外地采访娱乐盛事追踪各地影星，专访观众熟悉的歌影视红人，让大家瞬间掌握影视娱乐圈的动态和最新消息.

programme.title: 晚间新闻 News Roundup
programme.desc: 报导香港两岸国际重要新闻以及体育消息，让你洞悉各地大事及体坛动向.

programme.title: 爱情食物链 Love As A Predatory Affair
programme.desc: 从事食品供应的鲁佳芳阮小仪样子平凡，身材矮小，年过三十仍欠缺恋爱经验，因一次苦瓜事件，帮助餐饮业才俊刘柏业陈智燊渡过难关，令这位高富帅欣赏到佳芳的内在美，并与她渐生情愫，佳芳的邻居兼好友高贵芬高海宁对此无法释怀，卖鱼出身的贵芬样貌身材皆属女神级数，千方百计也未能令柏业过电，却召来台湾担仔面继承者洪鱻金刚的青睐，洪鱻为亲近贵芬不惜自贬身价与佳芳她们同住劏房，贵芬得不到柏业唯有转战二叔刘利高郑子诚，但后来柏业承受不了外界对女友佳芳的负评，二人关系亮起红灯；当爱情再不是饮水饱，美丑优劣再无标准，男女同时成了猎人与猎物，血肉横飞的恋爱激战即将一发不可收拾.

programme.title: 廉政行動2022 ICAC Investigators 2022
programme.desc: 十年前，唐偉聰袁偉豪飾與沈傲鳴譚俊彥飾同期加入廉署，兩人一起受訓，情同兄弟傲鳴因一次私自行動而受傷，未幾辭職，從此杳無音訊十年後，偉聰已晉升為總調查主任，並率領李進兒蔡思貝飾細粒陳曉華飾等下屬致力維護廉潔與公義偉聰於調查一宗懷疑銀行職員貪污案件時，發現傲鳴竟牽涉其中原來傲鳴憑其過往在廉署的調查經驗，助犯案集團多次避過各地刑事與反貪機構的偵查偉聰痛心好友忘記當年加入廉署捍衛公平公義的初心，誓要將犯案集團繩之於法！.

programme.title: 赤沙印记 四叶草.2 Sunshine Heartbeat
programme.desc: 沙滩上，少年十五二十时；他们抛汗， 他们随入情网叶菁杨婉仪叶蕙李思欣及叶茵陈自琦三姊妹小时侯 碰到一个古上贼女郎部容衢儿，女郎预言大家姐将在十八岁那年，遇见身上有四叶草胎记的真命天子转眼间三姊妹已长大，现在是清岚国际学校的中六生清岚沙滩排球队的队长干逸臣司徒瑞祈外表俊朗性格活泼，是校内的风头人物，很多女同学也为了他而加入沙滩排球队，犹如行星屋绕太阳一般一日，三姊妹分别在不同的角度看见臣身上有一个近似四叶草形状的胎记，跟小时侯听到的预言吻合，但菁为人优柔寡断没有主见，菁与茵因因此抛身而出，为制造机会给姐姐而不断奔走不久，三姊妹亦加入了沙滩排球队她们觉得的是，她们竟又在校内的垒学士方上发现四叶草胎记！三姊妹顿感迷闷，不知道吉卜赛女郎所言的真命天子究竟是谁.

programme.title: 食为奴 Gilded Chopsticks
programme.desc: 高天宝王祖蓝自小吃尽珍馐百味，各种美食经他一尝便知龙与凤，但遭逢家道中落被迫与家仆李卫胡诺言流落街头，以卖饱糊口，因美食令他结识了卖艺女子纪慕雪万绮雯京城第一美女年若碧胡定欣少女厨神米小鱼何雁诗等人，更因缘际会遇上微服出游的四皇子胤禛黄智贤，二人气味相投，被引进到宫内的御膳房当御厨，天宝遇上宿敌蔡鹤亭林盛斌，掀起连场龙争虎斗；但天宝万料不到自己竟卷入由八皇子胤禩张继聪策动的夺嫡之争中，在劣势下天宝成了胤禛的福将，连番替他反败为胜，但一段意外的婚约却令天宝由一人之下顿贬为丧家狗.

programme.desc: 高天宝王祖蓝自小吃尽珍馐百味，各种美食经他一尝便知龙与凤，但遭逢家道中落被迫与家仆李卫胡诺言流落街头，以卖饱糊口，因美食令他结识了卖艺女子纪慕雪万绮雯京城第一美女年若碧胡定欣少女厨神米小鱼何雁诗等人，更因缘际会遇上微服出游的四皇子胤禛黄智贤，二人气味相投，被引进到宫内的御膳房当御厨，天宝遇上宿敌蔡鹤亭林盛斌，掀起连场龙争虎斗；但天宝万料不到自己竟卷入由八皇子胤禩张继聪策动的夺嫡之争中，在劣势下天宝成了胤禛的福将，连番替他反败为胜，但一段意外的婚约却令天宝由一人之下顿贬为丧家狗.

programme.title: 爱情食物链 Love As A Predatory Affair
programme.desc: 从事食品供应的鲁佳芳阮小仪样子平凡，身材矮小，年过三十仍欠缺恋爱经验，因一次苦瓜事件，帮助餐饮业才俊刘柏业陈智燊渡过难关，令这位高富帅欣赏到佳芳的内在美，并与她渐生情愫，佳芳的邻居兼好友高贵芬高海宁对此无法释怀，卖鱼出身的贵芬样貌身材皆属女神级数，千方百计也未能令柏业过电，却召来台湾担仔面继承者洪鱻金刚的青睐，洪鱻为亲近贵芬不惜自贬身价与佳芳她们同住劏房，贵芬得不到柏业唯有转战二叔刘利高郑子诚，但后来柏业承受不了外界对女友佳芳的负评，二人关系亮起红灯；当爱情再不是饮水饱，美丑优劣再无标准，男女同时成了猎人与猎物，血肉横飞的恋爱激战即将一发不可收拾.

programme.title: 廉政行動2022 ICAC Investigators 2022
programme.desc: 十年前，唐偉聰袁偉豪飾與沈傲鳴譚俊彥飾同期加入廉署，兩人一起受訓，情同兄弟傲鳴因一次私自行動而受傷，未幾辭職，從此杳無音訊十年後，偉聰已晉升為總調查主任，並率領李進兒蔡思貝飾細粒陳曉華飾等下屬致力維護廉潔與公義偉聰於調查一宗懷疑銀行職員貪污案件時，發現傲鳴竟牽涉其中原來傲鳴憑其過往在廉署的調查經驗，助犯案集團多次避過各地刑事與反貪機構的偵查偉聰痛心好友忘記當年加入廉署捍衛公平公義的初心，誓要將犯案集團繩之於法！.

programme.title: 赤沙印記 四葉草.2 Sunshine Heartbeat
programme.desc: 沙灘上，少年十五二十時；他們拋汗， 他們隨入情網葉菁楊婉儀葉蕙李思欣及葉茵陳自琦三姊妹小時侯 碰到一個古上賊女郎部容衢兒，女郎預言大家姐將在十八歲那年，遇見身上有四葉草胎記的真命天子轉眼間三姊妹已長大，現在是清嵐國際學校的中六生清嵐沙灘排球隊的隊長干逸臣司徒瑞祈外表俊朗性格活潑，是校內的風頭人物，很多女同學也為了他而加入沙灘排球隊，猶如行星屋繞太陽一般一日，三姊妹分別在不同的角度看見臣身上有一個近似四葉草形狀的胎記，跟小時侯聽到的預言吻合，但菁為人優柔寡斷沒有主見，菁與茵因因此拋身而出，為製造機會給姐姐而不斷奔走不久，三姊妹亦加入了沙灘排球隊她們覺得的是，她們竟又在校內的壘學士方上發現四葉草胎記！三姊妹頓感迷悶，不知道吉卜賽女郎所言的真命天子究竟是誰.

programme.desc: 沙灘上，少年十五二十時；他們拋汗， 他們隨入情網葉菁楊婉儀葉蕙李思欣及葉茵陳自琦三姊妹小時侯 碰到一個古上賊女郎部容衢兒，女郎預言大家姐將在十八歲那年，遇見身上有四葉草胎記的真命天子轉眼間三姊妹已長大，現在是清嵐國際學校的中六生清嵐沙灘排球隊的隊長干逸臣司徒瑞祈外表俊朗性格活潑，是校內的風頭人物，很多女同學也為了他而加入沙灘排球隊，猶如行星屋繞太陽一般一日，三姊妹分別在不同的角度看見臣身上有一個近似四葉草形狀的胎記，跟小時侯聽到的預言吻合，但菁為人優柔寡斷沒有主見，菁與茵因因此拋身而出，為製造機會給姐姐而不斷奔走不久，三姊妹亦加入了沙灘排球隊她們覺得的是，她們竟又在校內的壘學士方上發現四葉草胎記！三姊妹頓感迷悶，不知道吉卜賽女郎所言的真命天子究竟是誰.

programme.title: 食為奴 Gilded Chopsticks
programme.desc: 高天寶王祖藍自小吃盡珍饈百味，各種美食經他一嚐便知龍與鳳，但遭逢家道中落被迫與家僕李衛胡諾言流落街頭，以賣飽糊口，因美食令他結識了賣藝女子紀慕雪萬綺雯京城第一美女年若碧胡定欣少女廚神米小魚何雁詩等人，更因緣際會遇上微服出遊的四皇子胤禛黃智賢，二人氣味相投，被引進到宮內的御膳房當御廚，天寶遇上宿敵蔡鶴亭林盛斌，掀起連場龍爭虎鬥；但天寶萬料不到自己竟捲入由八皇子胤禩張繼聰策動的奪嫡之爭中，在劣勢下天寶成了胤禛的福將，連番替他反敗為勝，但一段意外的婚約卻令天寶由一人之下頓貶為喪家狗.

programme.title: 愛情食物鏈 Love As A Predatory Affair
programme.desc: 從事食品供應的魯佳芳阮小儀樣子平凡，身材矮小，年過三十仍欠缺戀愛經驗，因一次苦瓜事件，幫助餐飲業才俊劉柏業陳智燊渡過難關，令這位高富帥欣賞到佳芳的內在美，並與她漸生情愫，佳芳的鄰居兼好友高貴芬高海寧對此無法釋懷，賣魚出身的貴芬樣貌身材皆屬女神級數，千方百計也未能令柏業過電，卻召來台灣擔仔麵繼承者洪鱻金剛的青睞，洪鱻為親近貴芬不惜自貶身價與佳芳她們同住劏房，貴芬得不到柏業唯有轉戰二叔劉利高鄭子誠，但後來柏業承受不了外界對女友佳芳的負評，二人關係亮起紅燈；當愛情再不是飲水飽，美醜優劣再無標準，男女同時成了獵人與獵物，血肉橫飛的戀愛激戰即將一發不可收拾.

programme.title: 巨輪 Brothers Keeper
programme.desc: 喬天生（陳展鵬飾）和羅威信（蕭正楠飾）是同母異父的親兄弟，因為命運令他們不單分開在香港和澳門兩地，更令他們嘗盡劇變歷史中的兩極衝突 母親周玉梅（李司棋飾）帶著小兒子威信在澳門當黑市居民，威信憑著努力和好朋友姚文英（田蕊妮飾）與龍飛（阮兆祥飾）的相助，歷盡艱辛，克服挑戰，最終踏上成功之路獨自在港自食其力的天生卻改走捷徑，聯結黑道古惑仔姜勇（張繼聰飾），與富家女發生關係，令女友卓靜（鍾嘉欣飾）傷心欲絕，最終落得人財兩空 本是唇齒相依的手足情，經歷時代巨輪的洗禮，前境變幻莫測，二人愈走愈遠，但一個信念深植在他們相連的血脈裡，縱然考驗再苦再難，終在一條又新又活的道路上重遇.

programme.title: 陪著你走 Every Step You Take
programme.desc: 雜誌攝影師宋天從胡杏兒因一場意外，失去了雙親也失去了光明，天性愛美和煲電視劇的天從卻未有自暴自棄，男朋友杜正恆張穎康和導盲犬的陪伴令她漸漸重拾自信，她的座右銘更是一句廣告標題愛是無所不能，成為她從傷痛中走出來的力量，誰料這個廣告的創作人甘言重陳豪如今就住在她的隔鄰因沉溺工作令言重失去所有朋友和同事，連徒弟阮婉姚子羚也決定辭職，言重有點迷失，決定放一個悠長假期，重回舊居生活，尋回昔日好朋友余加勁麥長青重回舊地，不單令言重重新出發，更讓他重新認識自己，男友移情別戀令天從再度陷入低潮，幸有言重在旁成為守護天使，二人風馬牛不相及的性格竟擦出了愛火花，以為看見的卻發現盲點，本是瞎眼的卻得見光明.

programme.title: 妳不是她 Youre Just Not Her
programme.desc: 食品公司銷售經理林信丁子朗飾時裝店老闆夏莉馮盈盈飾同居多時，愛情漸變平淡，兩人對將來也存在分歧情侶間日積月累的矛盾不滿一發不可收拾，林信夏莉爆發激烈爭吵下引致車禍經歷生死一剎後，踏實賢淑的夏莉變得熱情率性，事事以林信為中心，甚至介入其圈子，為林信的姊姊林善車婉婉飾上司麥美娜姚嘉妮飾競敵駱偉滔張頴康飾好兄弟穆家傑馬貫東飾和區文黃庭鋒飾帶來巨大衝擊！林信縱跟夏莉重拾初相識的浪漫與情愫，但眼前的她猶如判若兩人，林信不禁思疑對方還是否真愛？.

programme.title: 刀下留人 Executioner, The
programme.desc: 殺人無數的劊子手葉常綠黃德斌為保護恩公的媳婦阮素心姚子羚順利產子，將素心安頓在京城享負盛名的穩婆花蕊紅邵美琪家中，因而遇上離奇命案，常綠竟以其鬼頭刀救活了一條小生命，誰料這名來歷不明的男嬰令常綠和蕊紅無故捲入朝廷的政治漩渦，一冷一熱的配搭化解了一次又一次的危機，兩人在患難中漸生情愫；另邊廂，一對同在妓院長大的小情侶赤知秋楊明和祝小滿龔嘉欣來到蕊紅家，苦苦哀求常綠收知秋為劊子手的學徒，知秋其心不正，只想藉此逃脫受刑，常綠遲疑不決，一名神秘的彩戲師司馬丑陳山聰出現，令各人關係陷入錯綜複雜，男嬰身分之謎更因而被逐步揭開，但同時敲起了死神的喪鐘.

programme.title: 兄弟 Fist Fight
programme.desc: 來自英國的保鏢主管夏天行楊明，到港後奉命保護網絡教主張非凡王浩信，順道尋覓身世線索非凡行事張狂，還藉舉辦拳賽掩護竊密黑客赴港，期間屢遇險境麻煩，幸得天行一一化解事件引來火爆刑警何鐵男伍允龍關注，決心全力追查原來鐵男曾因一時衝動犯下不可告人的過失，性格亦漸走偏鋒拳賽同時激發三人的好戰天性，他們又逐漸發現彼此擁有相同的感應能力，藉以互助互救而三人背後的隱密連繫，更牽涉逾二十年前的金融風暴之戰.

programme.title: Isteri Dalam Sangkar
programme.desc: Aisyah mengenang saat dia kehilangan ibu dan bapanya, segala kenangan diimbas kembali dengan kesedihan yang tidak tertanggung. Kini, hidup Aisyah di penuhi dengan rasa sedih atas layanan dan sikap Mak Su Ainin dan dua orang sepupunya Fasha dan Farid. Aisyah melakukan semua pekerjaan di rumah selain mencari duit untuk diberikan kepada Mak Su Ainin sekeluarga. Sementara Fasha dan Farid hanya menanti Aisyah menandatangi surat penyerahan tanah kepada mereka yang dimiliki oleh arwah ibu dan bapa Aisyah. Semua ini atas arahan dan ajaran dari Mak Su Ainin. Iskandar lelaki yang hidup dengan kekayaan dan serba sempurna. Di kelilingi gadis-gadis cantik jelita persis model. Kehidupan dengan mengejar jawatan yang dijanjikan sebagai CEO di TG Holdings membuatkan Iskandar semakin hanyut melayari keseronokkan. Namun, cara hidup Iskandar tidak disenangi oleh Tengku Maria. Tengku Maria mula mencari jalan dengan menjodohkan Iskandar dengan Tengku Waiduri. Hal itu membuatkan Iskandar memberontak dan meminta Haziq membawanya bercuti.

programme.title: Cinta Dalam Sekam
programme.desc: Keadaan Uwan yang semakin merosot akibat demensia menyebabkan dia merayau tanpa alas kaki pada waktu malam. Pada 1988, pilihan Laila semakin terbatas, manakala Amanda mengambil langkah berani. Ketegangan yang memuncak turut mengancam persahabatan Imran dan Shafiq.

programme.title: Secebis Rindu
programme.desc: Rasya tak nak bertunang dengan Fahmi. Dalam hati Rasya dah ada Reeza. TA ikut Rasya. TA racun pemikiran Rasya. TA katakan yang Reeza adalah playboy dan telah membuatkan TM hamil. Rasya terkejut. TA juga beritahu yang dia tak sanggup nak teruskan perkahwinan dengan TM apabila tahu yang TM hamil anak Reeza. Rasya macam nak pitam dengar.

programme.title: Bisikan Pontianak
programme.desc: Selepas ditinggalkan suaminya, Suraya membesarkan dua orang anaknya sendirian di sebuah rumah terpencil. Namun apabila bekas suaminya kembali untuk menuntut tanah warisan, kejadian-kejadian aneh mula menghantui kampung mereka, memaksa keluarga itu berdepan dengan rahsia silam yang selama ini tersembunyi.

programme.title: Interchange
programme.desc: Dihantui oleh penglihatan yang suram, jurugambar forensik Adam berundur dari dunia, tinggal di rumah dan mengambil gambar jirannya sehingga dia diseret ke dalam penyiasatan lain oleh kawan baiknya, Detektif Man, yang meminta bantuannya untuk menyelesaikan siri pembunuhan ritual yang mengerikan. Pada masa yang sama, hobi Adam yang kelihatan tidak berbahaya tidak lama kemudian menjadi lebih gelap apabila dia mengintip Iva, seorang wanita muda dari Borneo. Terpesona olehnya, dia tidak lama lagi terjerat dalam rangkaian misteri dan pembunuhannya. Ketika Adam diseret lebih jauh ke dalam dunia puak Iva dan Man menyelidiki penyiasatannya dengan lebih mendalam, mereka menemui mistik bawah tanah bomoh dan makhluk ghaib di bandar itu.

programme.title: The Midwich Cuckoos EP2
programme.desc: Beberapa wanita disahkan hamil tanpa penjelasan. Ketegangan meningkat apabila kes ini menarik perhatian pihak luar.

programme.title: J Revolusi
programme.desc: Mengisahkan Jay Zulkarnain Haji Zul Ariffin, ketua Unit Tindakan Khas UTK yang digeruni penjenayah. Konflik tercetus apabila kakaknya, Dian Nur Fazura, ditangkap pengganas misteri, Andra Farid Kamil, yang memiliki Ultra Virus berbahaya. Jay ditugaskan menyekat ancaman virus itu sambil menyelamatkan kakaknya yang dijadikan tebusan. Namun, misi itu membawa tragedi apabila pasukannya terkorban, menimbulkan pelbagai tuduhan dan kejutan. Bersama rakan setugas, Eddie Izara Aishah dan Jiman Iedil Putra, Jay berjuang menentang masa dan musuh untuk menyelamatkan Dian dan menggagalkan rancangan Andra.

programme.title: Perempuan Ilmu Hitam EP10
programme.desc: Memaparkan Cairyl dan Azhar menyembunyikan diri kerana takut ditangkap polis kerana merogol Lisa, Sara dan Afifah. Mbah Nira mengaku mahu membantu Afifah dan Lisa bagi membalas dendam mereka. Sebaliknya, tiba di rumah Mbah Nira membuat pengakuan kepada polis dia yang membunuh Pak Samad kerana dendamnya 7 tahun lalu, Mbah Nira ditahan polis. Syamil mendapat rakaman video menunjukkan kejadian Lisa dan Afifah di rogol oleh Kumpulan Hunter termasuk membunuh Sara. Afifah dan Lisa kemudiannya menggunakan kuasa ilmu hitam untuk menangkap Cairyl, Azhar dan Bakri. Afifah mahu membunuh kumpulan Hunter tersebut menggunakan ilmu sihirnya, namun Lisa tidak membenarkan. Tiba-tiba, Polis menyerbu dan menahan Lisa dan Afifah selepas mendapat maklumat dari Syamil. Kedua duanya di masukkan dalam penjara.

programme.title: Misteri Wan Peah EP5
programme.desc: Farhan bercadang untuk pulang dan bekerja di kampung, bapanya tidak bersetuju. Pada satu malam, Aishah mengigau berjalan masuk ke dalam rumah Wan Peah. Siti meminta bantuan 3 sahabat karibnya membawa Aishah balik ke rumah. Li berkejar ke rumah Tok Hashim meminta pertolongan. Sesampai Tok Hashim ke rumah Wan Peah, Siti berjaya mengeluarkan anaknya, Tok Hashim terus mencari Wan Peah. Tiba-tiba muncul Wan Peah di hadapannya. Tok Hashim melarikan diri sambil meracau-racau.

programme.title: Bisikan Pontianak
programme.desc: Selepas ditinggalkan suaminya, Suraya membesarkan dua orang anaknya sendirian di sebuah rumah terpencil. Namun apabila bekas suaminya kembali untuk menuntut tanah warisan, kejadian-kejadian aneh mula menghantui kampung mereka, memaksa keluarga itu berdepan dengan rahsia silam yang selama ini tersembunyi.

programme.title: Perempuan Ilmu Hitam EP5
programme.desc: Memaparkan Pak Samad menerjah Nasrun kerana menyebabkan cucunya di rogol oleh Kumpulan Hunter. Perbualan mereka didengari oleh Lisa tentang kejadian rogol ke ats mereka 7 tahun lalu. Lisa mendapat profil perogol mereka dari Syamil, mereka sedang mengumpul bukti dan mahu Pak Samad menjadi saksi. Caryl tidak percaya yang penyakit Bakri disebabkan sihir ilmu hitam, sebaliknya Nasrun dan Azhar membawa Mbah Nira untuk mengubatinya. Namun Mbah Nira gagal memulihkannya. Satu malam, Azhar ternampak lembaga Bakri membunuh diri, sebaliknya Caryl syak Bakri mengambil dadah. Lisa menyerahkan profil perogol mereka kepada Afifa setelah mendapat maklumat dari Bayu, jam dihadiahkan oleh perogol kepadanya 7 tahun lalu sama seperti yang diterima oleh Bayu.

programme.title: Perempuan Ilmu Hitam EP6
programme.desc: Mengisahkan Bayu memberitahu Lisa, doktor Caryl yang menghadiahkan jam tersebut kepadanya. Jenama yang sama pernah dihadiahkan oleh Caryl kepadanya. Perkara tersebut dikongsikan oleh Lisa dengan Afifa. Mbah Nira minta Bakri dibawa ke rumahnya untuk diubati. Lisa terdengar perbulan Caryl dengan Azhar semasa berada di klinik, nama Bakri dan Nasrun disebut sebagai ahli kumpulan mereka. Lisa dan Syamil telah mengenali setiap ahli Kumpulan Hunter, namun mereka perlu mendapatkan Pak Samad untuk dijadikan saksi sebelum bertindak membuat laporan polis. Walaupun Afifa mendesak supaya tindakan segera diambil. Manakala Nasrun menghubungi Syamil bagi membantunya. Syamil dan Lisa ke rumah Pak Samad, malangnya mereka mendapati Pak Samad telah mati membunuh diri.

programme.title: Perempuan Ilmu Hitam EP7
programme.desc: Memaparkan Syamil dan Lisa menghubungi polis selepas mereka menemui mayat Pak Samad semasa ke rumahnya. Syamil datang ke rumah Bakri selepas dihubungi oleh Nasrun bagi mengubati sakit Bakri, malangnya Azhar terlebih dahulu membawa Bakri ke rumah Mbah Nira untuk memulihkannya. Kesempatan itu digunakan oleh Afifa bagi menggunakan ilmu hitam secara dalaman ke atas Bakri, walaupun pada fizikalnya Bakri telah disembuhkan oleh Mbah Nira. Lisa marahkan Afifa kerana melepaskan Bakri dan Azhar balik kerana peluang yang ada tidak digunakan bagi mereka membalas dendam. Di rumah, Bakri sekali lagi di rasuk sehingga hampir membunuh Azhar. Nasrun terpaksa menghubungi Syamil untuk memulihkan Bakri dengan menggunakan pendekatan Islamik. Akibatnya, Afifa terkesan dan hampir mati.

programme.title: Perempuan Ilmu Hitam EP8
programme.desc: Imbas kembali beberapa tahun lalu semasa Lisa, Sara dan Afifa tinggal bersama Mbah Nira. Namun Sara mati, bagaimanapun Mbah Nira menggunakan ilmu hitamnya menjadikan Sara sebagai Saka. Mbah Nira menurunkan ilmu hitamnya kepada Lisa dan Afifa. Kali ini, Cairyl dan Azhar bertindak menculik Afifa dan Lisa, mereka mendesak Lisa dan Afifa supaya mengarahkan Mbah Nira membebaskan Bakri daripada terus disihirkan. Tiba-tiba muncul Saka Sara menyebabkan Cairyl dan Azhar melarikan diri. Lisa dan Afifa balik ke rumah Mbah Nira, diketahui ilmu hitam yang dimiliki oleh Lisa lebih kuat berbanding Afifa. Bakri akhirnya meninggal. Nasrun merayu pertolongan Syamil, meminta Mbah Nira melepaskannya daripada disihirkan. Lisa bertindak menggunakan Saka Sara ke atas Azhar dan Cairyl.

programme.title: The Equalizer S1 EP2
programme.desc: Iklan dalam talian McCall membawanya kepada seorang ibu yang anaknya telah diculik oleh seorang pemerdagang manusia Thomas Beaudoin dan akan dibunuh melainkan dia mencuri maklumat sulit daripada majikannya, seorang ejen FBI. Selain itu, McCall meminta bantuan Aunt Vi untuk membongkar rahsia yang sedang disembunyikan oleh Delilah daripada mereka berdua.

programme.desc: Selepas bapanya, seorang ketua jenayah Vietnam yang berkuasa di Amerika Syarikat dibunuh secara kejam, tanpa diduga menjadi sasaran sindiket saingan. Terpaksa melangkah ke dunia berbahaya yang selalu dielakkannya.

programme.title: J Retribusi
programme.desc: Jay, bekas ketua Unit Tindakan Khas UTK, kini menjadi pengawal keselamatan kepada Nadi, anak Dato Hashim. Ketika Dato Hashim terperangkap dalam rancangan penjenayah, Jay, bersama Chang dan Amy, berjuang menyelamatkan Nadi dari menjadi tebusan. Dengan keberanian, strategi, dan semangat keluarga, mereka menentang musuh yang licik, menghadapi cabaran demi cabaran demi memastikan keselamatan Nadi dan menebus masa lalu Jay.

programme.title: Ceroboh
programme.desc: Selepas dunia dilanda makhluk asing yang dikenali sebagai Penunggu Langityang mampu mengawal minda manusiaenam rakan berlindung di sebuah bangunan usang. Namun apabila salah seorang daripada mereka terdedah kepada mereka, rasa curiga dan paranoia mula menjangkiti kumpulan itu, membawa ancaman yang lebih membahayakan daripada serangan di luar.

programme.title: Highland Tower
programme.desc: Pada Disember 1993, sebuah blok kondominium mewah runtuh selepas hakisan tanah dari lereng bukit bersebelahan. Kira-kira 50 orang terkorban dan kejadian ini sehingga kini menjadi salah satu tragedi paling gelap dan menyedihkan dalam sejarah Malaysia. Dua puluh tahun kemudian, pada 2013, sekumpulan pembuat filem dokumentari menjelajah ke dua blok yang masih berdiri untuk menjalankan ekspedisi memburu hantu. Apa yang mereka temui tidak sesuai untuk mereka yang lemah semangat.

programme.title: Detik 12 Malam EP5
programme.desc: Rancangan ini diterajui oleh pengantara Detik 12 Malam iaitu Saiful Azmi Jamsari serta dibantu oleh krew-krew produksi sebagai pembantu penyiasatan. Kali ini pengantara berada di sebuah banglo lama yang dikatakan penuh mistri terletak di Branang, Selangor. En. Solo Ambush seorang penjejak paranormal menemami perantara. Banglo ini pernah didiami oleh sebuah keluarga Cina, disebabkan berlaku beberapa kejadian misteri dan menakutkan, mereka berpindah keluar. Pengantara bersama Solo Ambush, berserta krew kemudiannya melakukan penyiasatan dengan berada di situ selepas 12 malam. Mereka sendiri mengalami situasi bunyi menakutkan sama saperti diceritakan. Namun tiada lembaga yang muncul. Solo Ambush berkongsi pengalaman semasa menjalankan siasatan di situ

programme.title: Estet
programme.desc: Mengisahkan para pekerja estet Cinta Manis yang bakal bertarung dengan kumpulan estet Red Cobra dalam satu perlawanan bola sepak yang sudah 20 tahun tidak diadakan. Farid dan Shashi, dua pekerja estet yang berkawan sejak kecil, menjadi harapan pekerja estet yang lain untuk menyelamatkan penindasan yang dilakukan oleh kerani estet, Pooniah. Seorang gadis cantik bernama Geetha tertarik hati dengan Farid dan Shashi. Sesi latihan dikendalikan oleh Subramaniam iaitu bapa Geetha yang dilantik sebagai jurulatih. Ayah kepada Shashi, Apaa, adalah pemain bola yang sangat mahir, tetapi telah berlaku insiden semasa perlawanan bola sepak estet itu dahulu yang mana kakinya patah diterjah oleh Junna, seorang samseng estet yang sengaja ingin menamatkan karier Apaa atas upahan Pooniah 20 tahun yang lalu. Berjayakah Farid dan Shashi serta kawan-kawannya membebaskan pekerja estet Cinta Manis daripada penindasan Pooniah?

programme.title: UsopWilchaMehghonjangMakhlukMuzium
programme.desc: Mengisahkan sebuah muzium yang ingin mengadakan satu pameran Hantu-Hantu Dunia untuk menarik minat pengunjung. Tanpa disedari, penganjuran pameran ini mempunyai matlamat tersendiri. Melalui perancangan licik sekumpulan pengamal ilmu hitam dari Romania, pameran ini sebenarnya ingin menghidupkan kembali Raja Dracula. Mengikut kepercayaan kumpulan ini, Raja Dracula akan dapat hidup kembali dengan mendapatkan darah manusia dari setiap benua.

programme.title: Tuah
programme.desc: Datuk Shaari dan Shahira diselamatkan oleh seorang lelaki yang mendakwa bahawa dirinya Hang Tuah, seorang pahlawan Melayu di abad ke-15. Meragui kisahnya, mereka membawanya melakukan pemeriksaan fizikal dan mental di hospital, lama-kelamaan Shahira mula mempercayainya. Tuah secara ajaibnya telah dibawa ke zaman moden dan mula mempelajari apa yang terjadi pada masa lalu. Akhirnya, Tuah pulang semula ke tempat asalnya dan mula membetulkan keadaan.

programme.title: Darah Satria
programme.desc: Berpangkat Leftenan Muda, Ariff terlibat dalam operasi memburu komunis di hutan. Mempunyai seorang isteri bernama Rafidah, namun terpaksa ditinggalkannya bersama ibu bapanya kerana sibuk menjalankan operasi. Dalam satu operasi menentang komunis, Ariff bersama anak buahnya melalui kesukaran yang menyebabkan Ariff mengalami kecederaan manakala salah seorang daripada mereka terkorban.

programme.title: UsopWilchaMehghonjangMakhlukMuzium
programme.desc: Mengisahkan sebuah muzium yang ingin mengadakan satu pameran Hantu-Hantu Dunia untuk menarik minat pengunjung. Tanpa disedari, penganjuran pameran ini mempunyai matlamat tersendiri. Melalui perancangan licik sekumpulan pengamal ilmu hitam dari Romania, pameran ini sebenarnya ingin menghidupkan kembali Raja Dracula. Mengikut kepercayaan kumpulan ini, Raja Dracula akan dapat hidup kembali dengan mendapatkan darah manusia dari setiap benua.

programme.title: Darah Satria
programme.desc: Berpangkat Leftenan Muda, Ariff terlibat dalam operasi memburu komunis di hutan. Mempunyai seorang isteri bernama Rafidah, namun terpaksa ditinggalkannya bersama ibu bapanya kerana sibuk menjalankan operasi. Dalam satu operasi menentang komunis, Ariff bersama anak buahnya melalui kesukaran yang menyebabkan Ariff mengalami kecederaan manakala salah seorang daripada mereka terkorban.

programme.title: Jiran
programme.desc: Mengisahkan Ramlan sekeluarga yang baru berpindah di sebuah kawasan perumahan. Namun, Ramlan melarang isteri dan anaknya Tina daripada bergaul dengan jiran-jiran mereka di situ. Ramlan sendiri beranggapan bahawa dengan berlaku sombong terhadap orang, dirinya akan dipandang mulia. Kesombongan Ramlan itu akhirnya menyusahkan dirinya sendiri apabila berlaku satu insiden yang melibatkan kehilangan Tina.

programme.title: Leftenan Adnan
programme.desc: Adnan memutuskan untuk menjadi seorang tentera dalam pasukan Askar Melayu setelah dikunjungi anggota tentera British yang datang ke kampungnya untuk merekrut lebih ramai anak tempatan. Tidak direstui keluarga, Adnan nekad untuk mengikuti latihan ketenteraan di Port Dickson. Perjuangan Leftenan Adnan dalam mempertahankan Tanah Melayu memberikan inspirasi kepada ramai anak muda tempatan.

programme.title: Tipu Kanan Tipu Kiri
programme.desc: Rudy, seorang jejaka tampan yang memiliki segalanya, Isterinya bernama Wulan, seorang penyanyi terkenal di Indonesia. Malangnya dalam syarat kontrak rakamannya, Wulan tidak dibenarkan untuk berkahwin. Untuk menyembunyikan perkahwinan mereka, Rudy dan Wulan berpindah ke Malaysia. Pelbagai kejadian lucu berlaku akibat kekeliruan dan suasana kelam kabut yang terjadi akibat penipuan mereka berdua.

programme.title: Tuah

Meragui kisahnya, mereka membawanya melakukan pemeriksaan fizikal dan mental di hospital, lama-kelamaan Shahira mula mempercayainya. Tuah secara ajaibnya telah dibawa ke zaman moden dan mula mempelajari apa yang terjadi pada masa lalu. Akhirnya, Tuah pulang semula ke tempat asalnya dan mula membetulkan keadaan.

programme.desc: Husin yang baru memulakan pekerjaan baharu dikejutkan oleh panggilan isterinya, Aminahayahnya, Pak Yusof, tidak pulang sejak keluar pagi tadi. Setelah mencari ke merata tempat, Husin akhirnya menemui Pak Yusof di sebuah perhentian bas dalam keadaan keliru dan ketakutan. Pak Yusof tidak ingat jalan pulang, malah tidak tahu di mana dia berada. Hairan dengan perubahan sikap ayahnya, Husin membawa beliau ke klinik. Di situlah mereka menerima berita yang mengejutkan: Pak Yusof menghidap Alzheimer. Dari saat itu, bermulalah perjalanan penuh cabaran buat Husin dan keluarganya dalam menjaga insan yang mereka sayangi.

programme.title: Father Son
programme.desc: Iman, seorang remaja, menjaga bapanya yang sakit. Selepas bapanya meninggal dunia, roh bapanya kembali untuk membantunya menghadapi sekolah, masalah buli, dan kehidupan cinta.

programme.title: Srimulat Hidup Memang Komedi
programme.desc: Mengisahkan perjalanan awal kumpulan komedi legenda Indonesia, Srimulat, yang berhijrah dari Solo ke Jakarta untuk mengejar impian mencipta nama. Dalam usaha mencapai kejayaan, mereka berdepan pelbagai cabaran, pengorbanan dan konflik, namun terus menghiburkan penonton dengan jenaka dan semangat yang tidak pernah luntur.

programme.title: Reaksiar

programme.title: 99 Nama Cinta
programme.desc: Kisah seorang penulis gosip terkenal yang bertemu lelaki berprinsip agama, lalu pertemuan itu mengubah cara hidup, pemikiran dan makna cinta dalam hidupnya.

programme.title: Ruang Temu
programme.desc: Program temu bual bersama Tony Eusoff yang mengupas pengalaman peribadi beliau berkaitan pengalaman beliau di dalam industri seni

programme.title: Adnan Sempit Sawadikap
programme.desc: mengisahkan Adnan Shaheizy Sam yang lucu, bersama isteri dan anaknya, memulakan perjalanan ke Thailand bersama sahabat baik mereka, Bobby dan Wawa, di mana pelbagai lagi pengembaraan menanti.

programme.title: Adnan Sempit Generasi Gig
programme.desc: Selepas menyelamatkan Nadia Afifah Nasir, seorang wanita moden yang telah lama diminatinya, Adnan Aiman Tino, seorang penghantar makanan, mula jatuh cinta tanpa menyedari bahawa dia mungkin terperangkap dalam rancangan tersembunyi wanita tersebut.

programme.title: Kau Langit Aku Laut

programme.title: By My Side
programme.desc: Sejak kecil, Faye dan Ben membesar bersama di Subang Jaya dan akhirnya jatuh cinta serta menjalinkan hubungan. Namun hubungan mereka diuji apabila Ben merancang untuk ke Australia, memaksa Faye belajar menghadapi cinta jarak jauh dan kehidupan tanpa dia.

programme.title: La Tahzan
programme.desc: Mengisahkan Viona, seorang wanita Indonesia yang tinggal di Jepun dan bekerja sebagai pengurus rumah kepada keluarga Muslim. Kehidupannya berubah apabila dia bertemu dengan Hasan, seorang lelaki yang menyimpan kisah silam dan rahsia dalam perkahwinannya. Konflik timbul apabila cinta, kepercayaan dan pengorbanan diuji, membawa Viona kepada perjalanan memahami makna kesabaran, keikhlasan dan ketentuan Tuhan.

programme.title: Karnaval SCTV 33
programme.desc: Setiap tahun, karnival SCTV mempunyai tema yang berbeza. Karnival ini menyajikan acara muzik yang paling menarik dan menampilkan ramai musikus serta selebriti terkemuka tanah air.

programme.title: Pelangi Untuk Nirmala
programme.desc: Persahabatan antara dua orang gadis, Pelangi dan Nirmala. Namun, persahabatan mereka ditentang oleh orang tua mereka kerana perbezaan strata sosial. Pelangi hidup dengan sederhana, sementara Nirmala hidup mewah.

programme.title: Saleha
programme.desc: Saleha mengisahkan seorang gadis baik hati yang ditinggalkan oleh ayahnya dan dibesarkan oleh nenek. Selepas diculik dan kehilangan neneknya, dia dipersalahkan dan dihalau oleh keluarganya. Dengan semangat dan keimanan yang teguh, Saleha memulakan hidup baru di Jakarta sambil menyembunyikan penyakit serius.

programme.title: Kenapa Kisah Cintaku Tak Seindah Tulisanku?
programme.desc: Anissa Rahmawati Icha Anissa kehilangan suaminya dalam satu kemalangan selepas pertengkaran mereka. Sebagai seorang penulis novel dan ibu, Anissa kemudian mengenali Mario Ridho Ilahi yang berjaya menambat hatinya dengan memberikan perhatian kepada anak-anaknya. Demi kebahagiaan mereka, Anissa bersetuju untuk berkahwin dengannya. Namun selepas perkahwinan, sikap sebenar Mario mula terserlah dan kehidupan Anissa berubah menjadi penuh konflik.

programme.title: Tertawan Hati

Pertemuan itu merapatkan hubungan mereka, namun tanpa disedari pelbagai rahsia dan konflik mula terbongkar, mengubah kehidupan kedua-duanya.

programme.title: Cinta Setelah Cinta
programme.desc: Starla menyangka dia telah menghadapi segalanya, tetapi penipuan Niko jauh lebih mendalam daripada yang disangkanya. Ketika dia terus berusaha mempertahankan perkahwinannya, ancaman baharu muncul. Ayu, yang masih taksub dengan Niko, semakin mengikatnya dalam perangkap dengan menggunakan anak mereka yang belum lahir sebagai umpan. Pada masa yang sama, naluri Starla merasakan ada sesuatu yang tidak kena, dan dia mula diburu oleh bayang-bayang serta rahsia gelap. Dengan keluarganya di ambang bahaya dan emosinya semakin tertekan, adakah Starla mampu melindungi orang-orang tersayang? Atau adakah pengkhianatan Niko akan mendorongnya melangkaui batas yang tidak boleh kembali?

programme.title: Ratman To The Rescue
programme.desc: Gossip magazine journalist Tong Leung-sing Sammy has unfortunately lost his left ear in a traffic accident. He gains mystical rat power after undergoing transplant surgery. Leung-sing keeps creating fake news just to benefit himself. He clashes with righteous policewoman Sung Hoi-yan Priscilla Wong, causing both of them to lose their jobs. With the support of her uncle Ming Kwan-ngai KK Cheung, Hoi-yan becomes a private investigator. Leung-sing is forced to help Hoi-yan with her investigation activities as Hoi-yan catches him using his mystical power to peep at goddess Ming Cheuk-kei Zoie Tam. Gold digger Tong Mei-fun Kamen Kong is cruelly harassed as rich clan heir Tsui Tsun-wai Daniel Chau and she become foes. Mei-fun forgives Tsun-wai and offers to help him as Tsun-wai gets into a difficult situation. Leung-sing becomes increasingly arrogant as he uses to his mystical power to solve cases. Meanwhile, Hoi-yan shockingly finds out Kwan-ngais real character. Leung-sing faces the danger of exhausting his mystical power and becoming a rat as he helps Hoi-yan.

programme.title: Scoop 2026

programme.title: News Treasury 2026
programme.desc: As the saying goes, Todays news is tomorrows history. With so much news every day, its hard for everyone to take it all in, let alone look back at history. History is a treasure troveif we ignore or underestimate it, we might miss out on its riches. The new program News Treasure Hunt guides viewers to uncover news gems from this vault. In addition to special features, live broadcasts, and series reports from the past, the show offers never-before-seen precious footage. Audiences will have the chance to revisit events such as Bruce Lees funeral, the Bank of Po Sang robbery, the Gang of Four trial, the Queens visit to Hong Kong, taxi strikes, the signing of the Sino-British Joint Declaration, an exclusive interview with Margaret Thatcher, Vietnamese refugees, the death of Governor Youde, Chris Pattens arrival in Hong Kong, the closure of Kai Tak Airport, the passing of Deng Xiaoping, the 1997 Handover Ceremony, the China Airlines Hong Kong crash, and SARS press conferences.

programme.title: Cantopop At 50

In addition to featuring influential senior artists in the music industry, the program also welcomes many singers who have not appeared in public for a long time, bringing multiple surprises to the audience.

programme.title: J Music 2026
programme.desc: J Music is dedicated to creating a high-quality music platform, providing singers with opportunities to showcase their musical talents while allowing music fans to gain a deeper understanding of their musical stories. programme.title: Chill. Hike. Camping
programme.desc: With travel restricted due to the pandemic, many people have opted to connect with nature and discover the joys of local outings and camping. Four former Miss Hong Kong contestantsHo Wing-sau, Liu Wai-yee, Wu Mei-yee, and Chan Yeuk-szeset aside their formalities and escaped the hustle and bustle of city life, joining various outdoor experts on adventures. They explored mountains and seas, experiencing outdoor activities like picnics, mountain art photography, car parking, diving, kitesurfing, and even taking on challenges like mountain art tests, boating to collect trash on deserted beaches, and rappelling on a deserted island. These diverse outdoor activities included experiencing a flash flood and witnessing the power of nature! Will they ultimately become Hong Kong wild women with exceptional physical strength, willpower, and environmental awareness?

programme.title: Music Money Monster
programme.desc: Pushing the limits of vocal range and precise timing, the brand-new interactive music game show Music Money Monster is hosted by Sammy, Eric Kwok, and Lee Yin-tung. Failure results in zero prize money! The amateur version allows solo participants to compete for a top prize of NT100,000. programme.title: Vital Lifeline
programme.desc: Urban dwellers often experience a hectic pace of life and high levels of stress, making them more susceptible to health problems. The Strongest Lifeline helps you unravel the secrets to good health. To start, the program features a four-episode series on common urban pain issues, covering headaches, shoulder and neck pain, back pain, and joint pain. Each episode invites medical experts to explain the causes of these conditions, as well as physical therapists and exercise specialists to teach appropriate exercises. With the growing trend of integrating Eastern and Western medicine, even American swimming champion Michael Phelps uses cupping therapy to relieve pain. Therefore, each episode also includes traditional Chinese medical diagnosis, complemented by treatments such as acupuncture, cupping, and the Sanfu herbal patch therapy, which is especially suitable during the hottest days of summer. In addition, Chinese medicine practitioners share recipes for nourishing soups, all of which can help regulate and improve your health.

programme.title: Return of the Cuckoo
programme.desc: Twenty years previously, CHU SHA KIU SIT KA YIN, NANCY met an undergraduate from Hong Kong, CHUK CHIN FAI KWOK FUNG and they immediately fell in love with each other. However soon afterwards, FAI decided to further his study in the United States. KIU, though had just found herself pregnant, agreed reluctantly to let him go just for the sake of his future. Since then, KIU has lived with her own daughter, CHUK KWAN HO SHEH CHARMAINE and her adopted child, MAN CHOR CHEUNG CHI LAM, JULIAN. Having been abandoned by her lover, CHORs mother flied into a fury of grief and gave CHOR, who was then an infant, a corrosive substance to drink. CHOR was fortunately rescued by KIU in time but his vocal cords had become paralysed because of the serious damage. CHOR regards HO as his sister and does not realise his extraordinary passion for her until SZETO LAI SHUN MA CHUN WAI, STEVEN appears. HO is an affectionate girl and is always full of tender solicitude towards all. She is thus torn by the confusing emotions of love for the three men around her, CHOR, SHUN and KAM SING TONG MICHAEL. CHORs voice begins to recover after the vocal operation conducted by a renowned surgeon. As he feels that he is unable to bring HO any physical well-being, he withdraws and has decided to leave for Hong Kong to look for his own mother. Meanwhile, by thinking of HOs future, KIU urges HO to depart from Macau and to live with FAI. Who will win HOs heart eventually? Will KIU be left alone by HO and CHOR?

programme.title: Like Mother, Like Daughter
programme.desc: Public relations queen TONG MAN-LEI Jinny Ng raises her Gen Z daughter TONG SUM Desta Lee alone and she is a control freak. MAN-LEIs mother, TONG CHO KA-BING Stephanie Che, has spent half of her life supporting her husband and raising their children. She is suddenly awakened and she returns to Hong Kong from Canada. She decides to reclaim her lost time and she moves into MAN-LEIs home. Many years ago, KA-BING and her daughter completely fell out because MAN-LEI insisted to have her daughter out of wedlock. Now, KA-BING suddenly breaks in without warning and disrupts MAN-LEIs life. MAN-LEI strives to maintain order, while TONG SUM mediates between the two, creating sparks and constant conflicts in this three-generation household. In the workplace, the wealthy heir, Marketing Guru YEUNG FAN Gary Chiu, is parachuted into the company to lock horns with MAN-LEI on equal footing. MAN-LEIs career and family are facing crises at the same time.

programme.title: Her Railway Trip Whats On Today
programme.desc: Japans railway world is incredibly diverse, stretching from winding valleys to coastal lines. Every train window is like a flowing landscape painting, captivating railway enthusiasts. In recent years, it has also attracted many women, giving rise to the unique nickname Tetsuko meaning railway girl. The program, led by up-and-coming actresses Ni Jiawen and He Yongshao, takes viewers on a journey through the charm of Japanese railway travel. It not only introduces the railways themselves but also explores the prefectures and cities traversed by the railways, showcasing the unique landscape created by the intertwining of railways and towns. Whether youre a railway enthusiast or a viewer who enjoys exploring new cultures, Tetsukos Lofty Mountain offers a romantic and surprising railway journey.

Hang-yu not only wants to get rid of that scumbag and her fake buddy, but also tries to bring the two together so that Suet-man can take over her original misfortune. Moreover, she makes good use of her dream memories and undergoes a glamorous makeover to strive for success in the workplace. programme.desc: Big City Shop introduces viewers to a wide range of timely topics, including seasonal products, health and wellness, fitness activities, skincare and makeup, fashion apparel, infant care, parenting knowledge, local delicacies, and pet care trends. The content is all-encompassing! In addition to hands-on demonstrations, experiences, or tests by the hosts, experts are invited to share their professional insights. In the cooking segment, several skilled culinary experts take turns showcasing simple and delicious healthy dishes and home-style recipes, helping everyone solve their cooking challenges.

programme.title: Like Mother, Like Daughter
programme.desc: Public relations queen TONG MAN-LEI Jinny Ng raises her Gen Z daughter TONG SUM Desta Lee alone and she is a control freak. MAN-LEIs mother, TONG CHO KA-BING Stephanie Che, has spent half of her life supporting her husband and raising their children. She is suddenly awakened and she returns to Hong Kong from Canada. She decides to reclaim her lost time and she moves into MAN-LEIs home. Many years ago, KA-BING and her daughter completely fell out because MAN-LEI insisted to have her daughter out of wedlock. Now, KA-BING suddenly breaks in without warning and disrupts MAN-LEIs life. MAN-LEI strives to maintain order, while TONG SUM mediates between the two, creating sparks and constant conflicts in this three-generation household. In the workplace, the wealthy heir, Marketing Guru YEUNG FAN Gary Chiu, is parachuted into the company to lock horns with MAN-LEI on equal footing. MAN-LEIs career and family are facing crises at the same time.

programme.title: The Tang Mist Whats On Today
programme.desc: Set during the Chuigong era of the Wu ZhouTang Dynasty, the story follows Di Renjie as he grows disillusioned with the political intrigues of Empress Wu Zetians imperial court. Leaving the capital to inspect the southern Jiangnan region, he is drawn into a series of five strange, seemingly supernatural cases

programme.title: Her Railway Trip
programme.desc: Japans railway world is incredibly diverse, stretching from winding valleys to coastal lines. Every train window is like a flowing landscape painting, captivating railway enthusiasts. In recent years, it has also attracted many women, giving rise to the unique nickname Tetsuko meaning railway girl. The program, led by up-and-coming actresses Ni Jiawen and He Yongshao, takes viewers on a journey through the charm of Japanese railway travel. It not only introduces the railways themselves but also explores the prefectures and cities traversed by the railways, showcasing the unique landscape created by the intertwining of railways and towns. Whether youre a railway enthusiast or a viewer who enjoys exploring new cultures, Tetsukos Lofty Mountain offers a romantic and surprising railway journey.

programme.title: Gourmet Express
programme.desc: Hong Kong brings together global cuisines, and its unique dishes and down-to-earth fare have captured the close attention of discerning food lovers! Food hosts and presenters such as Icy Wong,Snowy Choi,Carmen Ngai,Carmaney Wong , Jessica Liu , Gillian Ng keep up with the latest food news and deals, delving into the stories behind the flavors. Gathering firsthand information on popular eateries across various platforms, the hosts personally line up and taste the food, providing genuine reviews. Even takeout-only eateries with no dine-in option are in high demandwhat are the must-try picks? Running a food business inevitably comes with its own mix of sweet, sour, bitter, and spicy experiences. The production team follows the proprietors through their busy day, from sourcing ingredients and preparing materials to opening for business, uncovering the stories behind the flavors.

programme.title: I Go To Taiwan On Foot
programme.desc: The best way to understand the local customs and culture is through in-depth travel, exploring every corner of the city on foot, appreciating the scenery along the way, discovering the local life and culture, and embracing unexpected surprises and challenges. Shih Chao-ri and Tsai Ching-hsing were lured to Taiwan by a production team to film a reality show. Starting from Kaohsiung Airport, they conquered over 300 kilometers, traveling from Tainan to Taipei. Visiting eight cities in eight days, with only NT1,000 per day, the two racked their brains to solve problems like transportation and food, while also completing various assigned tasks, even exchanging labor for accommodation with limited resources, they had to use any means necessary to achieve their goals

programme.title: Big Boys Club
programme.desc: Big Boys Club is a youth talk show hosted by a group of close friendsBob Lam, Oscar Leung, Derek Wong, Philip Fan, and Alan Chan. In each episode, singers, entertainers, or guests from various fields are invited for relaxed interviews, presenting a wide range of topics including current social issues, pop culture, and trending interests. Matters of love, relationships, and even same-sex relationships are endlessly discussed topics for men and women alike. The show invites guests from diverse backgrounds to explore love and relationships, delving into the dynamics between the sexes. The Other Dimension segment features guests sharing extraordinary experiences, such as encounters with ghosts, UFOs, and bizarre happenings, bringing thrilling topics to the audience.

programme.title: Story of Kunning Palace
programme.desc: Jiang Xue-ning Bai Lu went to great lengths to become the Empress. But she was forced to take her own life in the palace. Fast forward to the present, and Jiang Xue-nings wish is to stay away from power struggles and control her destiny. However, she still somehow enters the palace as a study partner and becomes Master Xie Weis Zhang Linghe pupil. While learning from Xie Wei, Jiang Xue-ning plots to prevent Yan Lin Zhou Junwei from getting involved in the coming-of-age incident. By following Jiang Xue-ning and Xie Weis strategy, the Yans manage to stay alive. After the coming-of-age crisis, Jiang Xue-ning unwittingly gets embroiled in the imperial court crackdown on Lord Pingnan rebels scheme. She and Zhang Zhe Wang Xingyue venture into enemy territory. At the critical moment, Jiang Xue-ning uses her body to shield arrows for Zhang Zhe. But the duo eventually cannot stay together. Hostile the State of Yue launches an invasion. First Princess Shen Zhi-yi Liu Xening does not hesitate to go down the road to making peace by marriage. To save her buddy Shen Zhi-yi, Jiang Xue-ning goes with Xie Wei to the north to deal with the State of Yue. While overcoming difficulties, Xie Wei does not mind getting hurt as he protects Jiang Xue-ning. The duo gradually have affectionate feelings for each other. However, an even more evil conspiracy gradually surfaces, and it astonishingly points to the truth about the Lord Pingnan incident from twenty years ago. Jiang Xue-ning and Xie Wei eventually team up to uncover the truth from yesteryear. Jiang Xue-ning also uses love to influence Xie Wei. The couple eventually find happiness.

programme.title: Cause Of Death
programme.desc: Newly appointed female forensic pathologist Dr. Ching Chi-yan Hera Chan has always been inspired by Dr. Lam Sum Willie Wai. And ever since Chi-yan was a kid, she has aspired to join the Forensic Pathology Service. However, she is sidelined by her boss Dr. Lam Sum after starting her new job. Lam Sum and his ex-wife Ko Shuk-han Alice Wong, RCU Senior Inspector, cannot stand each other. Their paths cross again as their daughter Lam Suet-lui runs away from home. Chi-yan gains Lam Sums approval with her industrious work attitude and forms a bond with police officer Ko Chun Mark Ma. The three of them gradually become a well-coordinated crime-busting trio. She and seasoned reporter Tsim Pak-yu Nicholas Yuen evolve from playful rivals to supportive partners. Stylish Man The Chef containing not only the bomb of laughter, but the audience can also gain practical cooking knowledge throughout the program.

Through lively food challenges, scenic explorations, and authentic local encounters, the hosts bring audiences closer to Taiwans diverse flavors and vibrant traditions.

programme.title: Hot Door Night
programme.desc: Different in age, generation, and hosting style, these three hosts not only can sing, act, dance, and imitate, but are also skilled in cross-talk! With this unique combination, we hope to attract viewers of all ages and spark great entertainment.

programme.title: The Sound of Happiness
programme.desc: Wu is a senior police officer has always wanted a son to carry his family name and join the force. However, he and wife are bequeathed with four daughters! As a doting father, his chief objective is to help them find happiness in their marriages. In this charming drama, Wu his wife become their daughters greatest haven, through the ups and downs they face as married women.

programme.title: The Tradition Story of Taiwan
programme.desc: The Tradition Story of Taiwan presents a series of tales and folktales in Taiwan that have been pass down from one generation to another generation.

programme.title: MuMu
programme.desc: Mumu, a cheerful seven-year-old girl, lives with her deaf father in a deaf community and connects him to the outside world. However, their peaceful life is disrupted when her estranged mother reappears, pushing Mumu into the hearing world. Meanwhile, her father becomes ensnared by a gang that exploits the deaf to commit crimes.

programme.title: Look for a Star
programme.desc: Sam is a charismatic tycoon who has been divorced three times. When he meets Milan, a cabaret dancer and croupier, they immediately fall in love. However, their romance faces challenges when he proposes a prenuptial agreement, putting their budding relationship at risk.

programme.title: Shadows Edge, The
programme.desc: A team of skilled thieves pulls off a massive billion-dollar heist while outsmarting the Sky Eye surveillance system, shocking the city. To stop the criminals before they strike again, Macau police enlist retired surveillance expert Wong Tak Chung to rebuild an elite tracking squad and hunt down the elusive mastermind behind the operation.

programme.title: Soul Mate
programme.desc: July and An Sheng have been best friends since they were thirteen. They always believed their friendship would last forever, until they meet Su Jia Ming at the age of eighteen. The trio find themselves in a love triangle, which puts the girls friendship to the test and alters their destinies.

programme.title: Detrimental
programme.desc: You Ji Ren is a blind man who works at a factory on an outlying island. When the factory is cut off from the outside world by a hurricane one day, a monster appears and turns whoever sees it into black shadows. As You cannot see the monster, he is able to help his other co-workers escape safely and fight to kill the monster.

programme.title: Leap
programme.desc: At the 2008 Beijing Olympics, former volleyball legend Lang Ping shocked China by coaching Team USA to victory against her home nation. Years later, when Chinas womens volleyball team fell into a slump, she returned to rebuild the squad and eventually led them to a historic gold medal triumph at the Rio 2016 Olympics.

programme.title: Call of Heroes
programme.desc: Set in 1914 following the collapse of the Qing dynasty, the action-packed Call of Heroes tells the story of a group of villagers standing up to a cruel young warlord to protect their homeland.

programme.title: Welcome to My Side
programme.desc: After a painful breakup and a strange accident, Chen Xiao Zhou is haunted by flocks of quacking rubber ducks that only he can see. His bizarre curse disappears whenever he is with the cheerful Feng Jia Nan. As they grow closer, an absurd yet heartwarming romance blossoms, changing both their lives in unexpected ways.

programme.title: Mad Fate
programme.desc: A Master fortune teller predicts that Tung, a born psychopath, will be imprisoned for murder and tries to change his fate. A veteran detective believes Tung is a psychopathic serial killer after witnessing him kill a cat, and pursues him relentlessly. Can the Master change Tungs mad fate?

programme.title: The Monkey King
programme.desc: After Goddess Nuwa sacrifices herself to save the mortal world, Monkey King comes into being from one of her crystals. Powerful and uncontrollable, Monkey King challenges the Jade Emperor and causes an uproar in heaven, unwittingly creating an opportunity for the wicked Buffalo Demon King to wage war in heaven.

programme.title: Fox Hunt
programme.desc: Adapted from true events, Fraudster Dai swindled countless victims across China before vanishing without a trace. Seven years later, he resurfaces in Paris. Led by Detective Ye Jun, the Chinese Fox Hunt Team launches a high-stakes cross-border mission to recover the stolen assets and uncovers shocking secrets during the pursuit.

programme.title: Rob N Roll
programme.desc: A ruthless bandit, Tian, has plotted an intense and quick armed robbery. When he encounters Hui and Shui who also plan for a robbery, they decide to team up for the heist. However, their ad-hoc and dramatic robbery has started a war with the police hot on pursuit, putting their lives on the line!

programme.title: The Hedgehog
programme.desc: Wangs odd behaviour and quirky ideas make him a social outcast. His teenage nephew Zhou, who is ashamed of his stutter, becomes Wangs only friend. Together, these misfits challenge traditional family expectations and social misunderstandings, supporting and inspiring each other as they seek their own paths in life.

programme.title: Cesium Fallout
programme.desc: A massive fire caused by illegal garbage smuggling has triggered a radiation crisis in Hong Kong. Government advisor Simon joins the crisis response team led by Acting Chief Executive to avert the disaster. A fire brigade is tasked to enter the radiation zone and stop the cesium fallout. Facing the unprecedented catastrophe, can they save the city?

programme.title: Remember What I Forgot
programme.desc: Struggling with Alzheimers disease, Hong Kong film buff Kim relies on his brother to manage their appliance repair shop. Kims quirky behaviour prompts producer Ginger to suspect that he may be a film critic trying to profit from harsh reviews. Posing as a friend, Ginger uncovers Kims secrets and sorrows as she gets closer to him and his family.

programme.title: Welcome to My Side
programme.desc: After a painful breakup and a strange accident, Chen Xiao Zhou is haunted by flocks of quacking rubber ducks that only he can see. His bizarre curse disappears whenever he is with the cheerful Feng Jia Nan. As they grow closer, an absurd yet heartwarming romance blossoms, changing both their lives in unexpected ways.

programme.title: Beauty And The 7 Beasts
programme.desc: Teddy, once a renowned movie star, is facing a career decline. To make a living, he accepts five disciples to shape them into stars. Teddys career regains momentum after he reunites with his long-lost daughter, but he is also confronted by a rival at the same time. His daughter and disciples decide to help him overcome this difficult situation

programme.title: Time Still Turns the Pages
programme.desc: High school teacher Cheng recalls his violent childhood memories when he finds an anonymous suicide note in the classroom. While he has to prevent the tragedy involving a suicidal student from happening, he also has to face a series of family problems with his wife wanting to divorce him and his fathers serious illness.

programme.title: Beyond The Sin
programme.desc: The only daughter of Inspector Yan is brutally murdered, and her classmate Wen is arrested. Believing the case closed, Yan leaves the police force. However, when more girls are killed after Wens imprisonment, Yan begins to suspect the real killer is still at large and vows to find the truth.

programme.title: I Want to be Rich
programme.desc: Young Wah rises from a poverty-stricken background, carrying the heavy burden of caring for his gambling-addicted parents and younger siblings. Against all odds, his resilience and determination to provide a better life for his family eventually lead him to achieve significant success in real estatea testament that perseverance pays off.

programme.title: Ip Man 3
programme.desc: When some gangsters led by a ruthless American property developer force a school to sell their land, Ip Man fights to protect it. Subsequently, Ip Man is challenged by another Wing Chun master Zhang Tian Zhi for the Grandmaster title. Ip Man accepts the challenge for the sake of his family and disciples, and wins the duel for the title.

programme.title: Pursuit
programme.desc: This movie tells the tale of Lin Chong, the Sung Dynastys Chief Army Instructor who is framed by a corrupt official and has to embark on an exile fraught with danger. Helped by a monk, Lin Chong is finally able to take revenge.

programme.title: Heaven Sword and Dragon Sabre 2
programme.desc: Only by bringing together the powerful Heaven Sword and the mighty Dragon Sabre can six martial arts sects struggling for supremacy be saved in this thrilling sequel to Chu Yuans original hit.

programme.title: The Mermaid
programme.desc: Zhang and Jins daughter, Peony, are betrothed at birth but Jin objects to the engagement now. Zhang meets a carp spirit that looks exactly like Peony and they fall in love. When Justice Bao is asked by Jin to distinguish Peony from her replica, he decides to quit the case when he witness the true love between Zhang and the carp spirit.

programme.title: Legendary Weapons Of China
programme.desc: Lei Kung, the leader of the Boxer Clan in Yunnan, dissolves the clan to save his disciples before going into self-exile. The Clan sends various assassins to kill him but failed. They then assigned Kungs brother Yong to find and kill Kung, leading to a battle between the two brothers.

programme.title: The Twin Swords
programme.desc: Gui Wu and his wife Gan Lian Zhu are the famous Twin Swords in the martial arts world. One day, they stumble upon a kidnapping plot at the Red Lotus Temple and Lian Zhu is held captive. Wu successfully escapes to find the Gan family for help, not knowing that he is sending them into an ambush by the kidnappers. Can he finally save Lian Zhu?

programme.title: Operation Lipstick
programme.desc: A professors assistant stole a micro-film storing the secret of a newly invented nuclear reactor and sells it to a crime syndicate. However, the micro-film accidentally falls into the hands of a nightclub dancer and a thief in the process, leading to them being relentlessly pursued by the crime syndicate to retrieve the micro-film.

programme.title: Asia-pol
programme.desc: Asiapol agent Yang Ming Xuan trails a shipment of contraband gold being delivered to gang leader, George Eaton. He enlists the help of a Chinese woman who is trying to avenge her sister and narrowly escapes several deadly traps as he closes in on Eatons location. This spy film is loosely inspired by the James Bond movies.

programme.title: Lion VS Lion
programme.desc: The traditional lion dance has never looked so good as in Lion VS Lion which captures the most impressive sequences of lion dancing on film. Besides being loaded with enjoyable martial arts chicanery, film historians can revel because its also the first film that clearly demonstrates the intricacies and differences between the traditional Northern and Southern lion dancing techniques. The Five Venom alumnus and Chang Cheh discovery, Lo Meng, teams up with Liu Chia-liang protege Wang Yu, as they inadvertently turn from vagabond kung-fu school operators into anti-Ching, patriotic fighters.

programme.title: Forever And Ever
programme.desc: Ivy Ling Po plays a young scholar who is manipulated into marrying a noblemans reluctant daughter. After marrying, he soon discovers the reason for her hesitation. She is stricken with a contagious disease. But, with the power of true love, their romance prevails.

programme.title: A Deadly Secret
programme.desc: A corrupt magistrate, obsessed with finding a hidden treasure, jails and tortures his daughters lover and buries his daughter alive! Ironically, it is in her coffin that the secret to the hidden treasure is found, setting off a frenzy of destruction.

programme.title: The Happiest Moment
programme.desc: This erotic comedy anthology features three stories about an old man who dies from an overdose of virility pills, a cop who goes on the run after extorting money from a hooker, and a barbers apprentice who encounters a lively corpse in a night vigil. Through playing all these characters, Michael Hui proves himself as a genius of Hong Kong comedy.

programme.title: Executioners From Shaolin
programme.desc: The White-Browed Priest supports the brutal Qing government, burning down Shaolin Temple and hunting its disciples. Shaolins Hung falls in love with Fang while escaping the hunt and the couple have a son before Hung is killed by the Priest. To avenge his father, Hungs son creates a new form of martial art combining his parents kung fu styles.

programme.title: Lady Of The Law
programme.desc: Chan, the chief of Wan Sheng Escort, is forced to raise his opponents son, Yim. While Chan forbids Yim to practice martial arts, Yim secretly learns it. Ten years later, a rapist appears and Yim is arrested by a lady constable as the suspect. The rapist turns out to be Chans elder son and Yim is framed by the Chans. Can Yim prove his innocence?

programme.title: Lady Of The Law
programme.desc: Chan, the chief of Wan Sheng Escort, is forced to raise his opponents son, Yim. While Chan forbids Yim to practice martial arts, Yim secretly learns it. programme.title: Reincarnated Swordsman
programme.desc: Yun Fei Yang, a Wudang servant hiding his identity as the sect leaders illegitimate son, is framed by long-hidden enemies and branded a traitor after losing his father. Hunted by rival forces and stripped of his martial arts, he masters the legendary Tian Chan Gong and rises again to clear his name and settle a generations-old blood feud.

programme.desc: Jenny Hu, Shaw Brothers gorgeous Chinese-German star, was given her first comedy role in the wild and wacky Guess Who Killed My Twelve Lovers? Described as a comedy of belly laughs and chilling murders, it is a unique entry in the Hong Kong theater of the absurd.

programme.title: Melody of Love
programme.desc: Three young doctors pursue three hard-to-get beauties in this romantic film set in the 70s a-go-go era. They have no idea where to start and use Rock-paper-scissor method to match themselves with the girls. The tactics and tricks they use are hilarious and they have to reshuffle their plans when nothing leads to success!

programme.title: Scandal
programme.desc: The roguish scamp Zhen and his best friend Chia collects proof of corruption from the officials in this comedy-drama. After a string of blackmailing, they end up in positions of power, but what is to happen next?

programme.title: Golden Swallow
programme.desc: A heroine finds herself in a love triangle with a swordsman and a warrior. They team up to conquer the evil forces of the martial arts world but she is unable to choose between both men even as they face a deadly duel.

programme.title: The Human Goddess
programme.desc: Seventh Sister, a curious fairy from heaven, descends to 1970s Hong Kong. Lost in an unfamiliar world, she is rescued by Tung Chi Lap, who runs a debt-ridden orphanage. When a tycoon plots to seize the land, she uses her powers to protect it, and an unlikely romance begins.

programme.title: Angel with the Iron Fists
programme.desc: Lo Wei directs and stars as the chief detective in this gripping thriller playing alongside Lily Ho, who excels in the role of an undercover avenger that can fight as well as she flirts! Caught between the crime bosses known as Baldhead and Black Widow, she only has four choices: punch, kick, shoot or bombard with explosives!

programme.title: The Big Sting
programme.desc: Three buddies find a rare artifact known as the Double-Faced God but are poisoned by Lady Wu who steals the treasure from them. Before they die, they get their wives to promise to train their children to take back what is rightfully theirs. These kids grow up to exact a vengeance that turns out to be more hilarious than horrific in this comedy.

programme.title: The Hidden Power Of Dragon Sabre
programme.desc: Defeated villain Sung Ching Shu returns and starts a reign of terror, trapping a beautiful Mongolian Princess and mastering the yin and yang combination to become almost invincible. Only two swords held by two great swordsmen can stand in his way!

programme.title: The Grand Substitution
programme.desc: In this Opera epic, a loyal Imperial Court servant gives up his own newborn son to save the prince from an evil official.

programme.title: The Golden Lion
programme.desc: The Golden Lion is a bandit with good martial arts skills and often robs from the rich to help the poor. He is ambushed and attacked by a gang one night but luckily finds help from a master healer, who has to find a way to treat him while they are both being chased by the gang.

programme.title: Akhanda
programme.desc: Akhanda, a devotee of Lord Shiva, protects Murali Krishna from Varadarajulus evil scheme. The story unfolds with divine intervention, bringing justice in a captivating tale of righteousness.
After mobiles start mysteriously flying out of the hands of people in Chennai, Dr Vaseegaran summons his trusted robot Chitti to ward off the bird-shaped supernatural powers of Pakshirajan.

programme.title: Heartiley Battery
programme.desc: Sophia always grew up believing that love is nothing but a figment of science. At 24, she builds a Love Meter to evade heartbreaks and meets Sid, a free-spirited writer, who soon falls for her.

programme.desc: 有近百年歷史的日本武術 合氣道，主要特點是在以柔克剛借勁使力不主動攻擊當中有不少禮儀及基本功，今集就帶大家了解這一種武術

programme.title: 大鳴大放
programme.desc: 近年中國積極布局北極航道，冰上絲綢之路8月15日起開啟每周一班常態航道香港極地研究中心紫荊站創辦人何建宗接受大鳴大放專訪時指出，極地冰層下天然資源豐富，唯現時開發成本高，需預早布局；他透露內地已有4家公司對冰上絲綢之路有興趣這條冰上絲綢之路由寧波舟山港出發，到英國利克斯港，需時20日，較傳統航線40天縮短20天何建宗指計算航行里數已減少很多，現在航行的兩條航線，一條是走中東路線經過沙地阿拉伯，蘇彝士運河地中海；另一條航線更長，走南非好望角，若行走北極航線，相比走蘇彝士運河航線減少3500公里，亦相比非洲航線少了7000公里，節省航行燃油，減少碳足跡，對環保有好處，亦能掌握貨運高峰期的機遇何建宗續指現時貨運航線行走馬六甲海峽，經過新加坡，將來北極航線成熟的話，對這些附近的城市都會構成威脅；他透露新加坡的基金已經積極投資在北歐港口本身是海洋生態學教授的何建宗，指北極天然資源豐富，百分之65以上是海洋，水深達3000至4000米，冰層下汪洋仍未開發，蘊藏天然氣石油可燃冰，豐富的礦產有鈾礦矽鋁土鎢礦等，現因冰天雪地開採成本貴，然而若展望將來技術水平可達到經濟開發，現在就要預先布局何建宗指特朗普提出格陵蘭主權問題，是深謀遠慮看通格陵蘭在北極航道的重要性，何建宗指格陵蘭位於西北航線，若能掌握西北航線，對美國的貿易經濟發展很重要：如果美國俄羅斯爆發核戰，都是在北極上空攔截他續指冰融已是無可避免的現實問題，發展北極航運要有很好的環境管理，他指國家2018年發表中國的北極政策白皮書，不僅是開發，還要可持續性發展，愛護北極，所以在法制上加入環境評估全國人大巳審議中華人民共和國生態環境法典，中國將來會在北極圈進行環境評估，然後才讓航運或漁業發展香港配合國家發展大局，可發揮優勢，香港擁有自由港的傳統優勢，發展航運業，另外碳金融和ESG有一定機遇，香港亦可發展相關旅遊博物館等

programme.title: 經緯線
programme.desc: 五十八歲的陳天翀三年前將工業電子生意從香港遷至肇慶，每周一清晨，他便從元朗出發，經福田口岸深圳北高鐵，花三小時到公司他會在肇慶逗留至周四才返港，因此他在肇慶，以月租不足兩千元人民幣租了個三房單位他的公司面積兩萬呎，租金僅香港六分之一他指公司營業額連年增長，他形容競爭力死守香港只會越來越小然而三年來太太獨力照顧三名子女，小女兒出現情緒問題，太太亦曾因房屋淹水崩潰，埋怨老公不在的日子，我天天沒有自己的時間，認為一家人齊齊整整，關係比金錢更重要陳天翀坦言兩頭不到岸，但希望盡快賺夠錢退休團聚五十一歲的廖天威從事商務車司機十三年，一年前賣了黃埔單位，帶太太和兩名女兒搬往深圳羅湖一千二百呎單位月租四千五百元人民幣，加車位總數和之前香港租個車位差不多他算過一筆賬：香港基本開銷近四萬港幣，深圳還不到一萬元人民幣，身上的擔子輕了他說他和家人仍回香港上班上學看醫生，每天交通時間超過三小時，但他從不後悔，說一家人很快融入深圳生活，居住環境變好，關係也更融洽，他說搬到深圳的決定超級值得，應該早點搬根據政府統計處數字，在廣東省逗留半年或以上的香港永久居民，由2016年的52.1萬人增至去年近59萬，升幅13另外，一間銀行曾進行調查，指近一千四百名擁有過百萬港元流動資產的港人中，每五人有一人已在廣東省及香港雙城居住，每三人有一人考慮移居大灣區內地城市香港大學人口研究中心總監方偉晶認為，部分中產用交通時間換空間，衝擊香港消費，但港人往返亦帶來間接好處，在內地的文化和做事方式，可幫助香港營商不是零和博弈，兩邊走終究是過渡，到了某個時間，總會選擇一邊長住跨境兩邊走，有人如釋重負，有人指兩頭不到岸用距離換空間，用分離換生計，家庭的代價與生活的質素，該如何平衡？

programme.desc: 유아들이 일상생활 속에서 갖게 되는 흥미로운 궁금증과 호기심을 중심으로 다양하게 탐구해나가는 사고력 증진 프로그램입니다. 유아들의 눈높이에서 제기된 참신한 호기심 아이템을 선정하고, 선정된 아이템은 유아 스스로 추론하고 탐구할 수 있는 직접 체험과 다양한 활동 및 시청각 매체를 총동원하여 전개해나갑니다. 이러한 다양한 경험과 활동을 통해 유아들은 새로운 자극을 받게 되고 또 다른 도전감과 새로운 호기심으로 발전해나가면서, 창의적인 아이로 자라날 수 있을 것입니다. 사랑스러운 모야멍, 재미있는 웅이형, 친절한 동이언니, 그리고 우리의 친구 뚝딱딱 삼총사와 함께 호기심의 나라로 날아가볼까요?

programme.title: 로보카 폴리
programme.desc: 아름다운 섬마을 브룸스타운에는 날마다 크고 작은 사고가 끊이지 않는데... 사건이 일어날 때마다 로봇으로 변신하는 용감한 구조대, 로보카 폴리 출동!

programme.title: 어린 철학자
programme.desc: lt어린 철학자gt는 정답을 맞히는 아이가 아니라, 자신만의 생각을 가진 아이로 자라도록 돕는다. 질문하고, 사유하고, 자신의 기준을 세우고, 주장할 줄 아는 인간으로 성장하는 시간! AI 시대, 대체 불가능한 인간이 되는 가장 근본적인 힘 - 철학 하는 힘을 키운다.

programme.title: 극한직업
programme.desc: 우리 사회에는 상상을 초월하는 극도로 힘든 작업환경 속에서 일하는 사람들이 있다. 이런 극한의 직업에 종사하는 사람들의 삶을 밀착 촬영하여 생생하게 보여줌으로써 역경을 극복하고 살아가고자 하는 사람들의 숭고한 의지와 잃어가고 있는 직업정신의 가치를 되돌아본다.

programme.title: 일요시네마 lt굿 윌 헌팅gt
programme.desc: 이 영화의 시나리오는 50페이지 분량에 불과한 단편소설에서 출발했고, 단편소설을 쓴 사람은 다름아닌 윌 헌팅의 배역으로 열연한 맷 데이먼.1998년 제70회 아카데미상 후보선정에 최우수 작품상, 남우주연상 등 9개 부문에 노미네이트되었고, 그해 골든글로브 상에서는 최우수 각본상을 수상했다.맷 데이먼과 벤 애플렉이 할리우드에 입성하게 된 계기가 된 영화.

programme.title: EBS 다큐프라임 스페셜
programme.desc: 아이의 사생활, 한반도의 공룡 등 많은 화제작과 동물, 음식, 여행 등 다양한 주제와 형식으로 남녀노소의 많은 사랑을 받고 있는 프로그램으로 시청자들의 지적욕구를 만족시켜 준다

programme.title: 금수미앙
programme.desc: 군웅이 할거하고 전쟁이 끊이지 않던 남북조 시대, 북위와의 전쟁에 패한 북량의 황제는 나라를 구하기 위해 북위에 볼모로 끌려간다. 북량의 공주 심아는 천진난만하고 근심 걱정 없는 명랑한 소녀로 주변 사람들의 사랑을 받으며 남부럽지 않은 유년시절을 보내고... 아버지가 북위에서 돌아온 날, 북량은 북위 태부 집안의 계략에 의해 하룻밤 새 멸망한다. 북위의 공격에 도망치던 심아는 우연히 이미앙을 만나 도움을 받지만 이미앙은 죽임을 당하고... 자신의 인생을 모두 앗아가버린 원수와 그 일족을 무너뜨리기 위해 심아는 이미앙의 신분을 빌려 북위를 향한 복수를 시작하는데...

광복80주년 특집기획 다시보는 속기록 대한민국 정치사
programme.desc: 우리 민족은 기록에 관해서는 대단한 저력을 지니고 있다. 유네스코에 세계문화유산으로 지정된 조선시대의 승정원일기가 그렇고 그 사초를 바탕으로 편찬한 조선왕조실록이 그렇다. 현대 의회 민주주의의 전당, 국회에도 이러한 기록에 있다. 국민의 대표기관인 국회의 의정활동을 낱낱이 기록하는 속기록이 바로 그것. 여의도 국회 30주년을 맞아 국회방송에서는 총 16부에 걸친 연작 다큐멘터리 다시보는 속기록연출 조정훈을 제작, 방송한다. 이 프로그램은 질곡의 대한민국 현대사를 국회 속기록이라는 프리즘을 통해 재조명하고, 우리에게 주는 질책과 교훈을 담아낼 계획이다.

programme.title: 아기공룡 둘리
programme.desc: 아기공룡 둘리quot를 1983년부터 10년간 보물섬에서 연재하던 원작자 김수정씨는 국산 만화 캐릭터를 지속적이고, 세계적인 캐릭터로 성장 시키기 위해서는 조직적인 활동의 필요함을 느끼고 1995년 2월에 주둘리나라를 설립했다.1996년 7월 장편 만화영화 quot아기공룡 둘리quot를 제작하여 COEX 외 전국 극장에서 상영했으며 현재 미라클에서 비디오 테이프제작 판매중이다.1999년 1월 17일 베를린을 시작으로 독일극장에 상영했었고, 독일 영화개봉에 맞춰 음반 및 비디오, 게임도 같이 판매하는 큰 성과를 올렸다.

programme.title: 네모바지 스폰지밥
programme.desc: 어린이들 사이에서 최고의 인기를 자랑하고 있는 바닷속 네모난 친구는 누구일까요? 기상천외하고 유쾌하면서도 매력만점의 주인공 스폰지밥을 만나보세요! 저 깊은 태평양 바닷속, 비키니 씨티라는 해저도시에는 네모낳고 노란 해면동물 스폰지밥과 친구들이 있습니다. 스폰지밥은 애완동물인 달팽이 핑핑이와 함께 파인애플 집에 살고 있습니다. 스폰지밥의 장기는 정말 맛있는 음식을 척척 만들어 내는 멋쟁이 요리사라는 점과 언제나 모든 소동과 사건의 현장에 있다는 것입니다! 괴팍한 이웃 친구 징징이를 괴롭히는 것도 스폰지밥의 또다른 특기죠. 스폰지밥의 단짝 친구는 솔직하고 사랑스러운 불가사리 뚱이, 그리고 스릴만점의 모험을 즐기는 여자친구인 다람이입니다. 꿈과 환상의 도시인 비키니 시티 에서는 물고기 친구들이 걸어다니고, 게살버거가 가장 맛있는 음식은 이라고 하네요. 지금 바로 바닷속에 뛰어들어서 스폰지밥의 매력에 흠뻑 젖어보세요!

programme.title: 신비아파트:고스트볼의 비밀
programme.desc: 귀신이 나오는 장소로 유명한 신비아파트, 그것도 444호에 이사 오게 된 하리네 가족. 첫날부터 그들은 자꾸만 이상한 일들에 휩싸이게 된다. 아무도 안 산다는 위층에선 밤새 쿵쿵거리는 소리가 울리고, 아파트 맨홀에서 기어 나온 괴상한 꼬마 아이는 자꾸만 내기를 하자며 하리에게 덤벼든다. 그러다 얼떨결에 꼬마 아이가 입에 달고 다니는 엿을 빼앗아 먹게 된 하리와 동생 두리. 그 이후부터 그들의 눈엔 하나둘 무서운 귀신의 모습이 보이기 시작하고, 정체를 알 수 없는 맨홀 꼬마는 귀신을 없애주면 원하는 소원은 뭐든지 이루어주겠다며 큰소리치는데...
